title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（小田忍研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Oda Shinobu)
teachers:
ODA Shinobu
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn the basic information for their own research theme.
(2) learn the analysis of information for their own research theme.
(3) learn the method of construction of their own experiments.
(4) learn writing techniques for scientific reports.
(5) learn oral presentation techniques to achieve their own presentation goals.
advice:
Students will collect and analyze information related to their own study theme, conduce precise experiments, analyze large amounts of data gained via the experiments, and construct subsequent experiments based on the information gained. In this course, students will also have to:
  (1) present their own experimental results gained and complete Q&A in monthly laboratory meetings.
  (2) input their own activity record into a PC as a weekly report.
  (3) work on English paper translation and submit reports every week.
  (4) work on the experiments seriously to achieve meaningful experimental data.
  (5) help other students with their experiments as necessary.

activityGoals.body: Ability to achieve research goals along a research course.
Ability to learn about microorganisms, reagents, and methodology for independent research.
Ability to plan experiments, complete the experiments, and discuss the results gained.
Ability to complete aseptic experiments with microorganisms and chemical experiments.
Ability to precisely explain independent experimental achievements in oral/poster presentation and papers.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully collect and analyze the information of the research theme.
(2) Fully construct appropriate experimental planes.
(3) Fully work on the experiments for the research theme.
(4) Prepare complete figures and tables from data gained.
(5) Fully discuss the data and related information.
(6) Fully plan the future schedule based on the discussion.
(7) Fully explain the research outcomes.
(8) Write a complete report with the research outcomes.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Moderately collect and analyze the information of the research theme.
(2) Moderately construct appropriate experimental planes.
(3) Moderately discuss from the data and related information.
(4) Moderately plan the future schedule based on the discussion.
(5) Moderately explain the research outcomes.
(6) Write a sufficient report with the research outcomes.

              Students will:
(1) learn the basic information for their own research theme.
(2) learn the analysis of information for their own research theme.
(3) learn the method of construction of their own experiments.
(4) learn writing techniques for scientific reports.
(5) learn oral presentation techniques to achieve their own presentation goals.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

               Students will collect and analyze information related to their own study theme, conduce precise experiments, analyze large amounts of data gained via the experiments, and construct subsequent experiments based on the information gained. In this course, students will also have to:
  (1) present their own experimental results gained and complete Q&A in monthly laboratory meetings.
  (2) input their own activity record into a PC as a weekly report.
  (3) work on English paper translation and submit reports every week.
  (4) work on the experiments seriously to achieve meaningful experimental data.
  (5) help other students with their experiments as necessary.
